steps: Identify the initial volume of the cube: V = (10 cm)^3 = (100 mm)^3 = 10^6 mm^3.
Use the definition of bulk modulus: B = ΔP / (ΔV / V).
Rearrange to solve for volume contraction: ΔV = (ΔP * V) / B.
Substitute the given values: ΔV = (7 × 10^6 Pa * 10^6 mm^3) / (1.4 × 10^11 Pa).
Calculate the final value: ΔV = 50 mm^3.
